final: WITH filtered_fees AS (SELECT * FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005), order_aggregates AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate IS NOT NULL AND feerate IS NOT NULL THEN rebrate / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio FROM filtered_fees GROUP BY orderslink), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio FROM order_aggregates WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), with_relative AS (SELECT oa.orderslink, oa.avg_rebtotal, oa.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN om.mean_ratio IS NOT NULL AND oa.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL THEN oa.avg_ratio / om.mean_ratio ELSE NULL END as relative_ratio FROM order_aggregates oa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om) SELECT orderslink, avg_rebtotal, avg_ratio, relative_ratio FROM with_relative ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
